title.description: Title of the agreement as written at the top of the document

clauses.description: Every top-level numbered section of the agreement, in order. Do not include sub-clauses.

role_label.description: Defined term used for this party, e.g. Supplier, Customer

parties.description: The legal entities that are parties to the agreement. Not individuals, not courts, not states.

expiry_date.description: Only if an explicit end date is stated. Do not compute.

party_name.description: Legal entity the person signed for

signatories.description: People who signed, from the signature block

dispute_resolution.description: The mechanism that actually applies. If arbitration is excluded, do not answer arbitration.

payment_terms_days.description: Days after invoice by which payment is due

liability_cap_basis.description: How the cap is defined, in a short phrase

renewal_notice_days.description: Days of notice required to prevent renewal

liability_cap_amount.description: Fixed monetary cap, if any number is stated

liability_exclusions.description: Carve-outs to which the liability cap does not apply

termination_for_convenience_party.description: Which party or parties may terminate for convenience
